mechanism: Both drugs are nephrotoxic and can cause additive renal impairment and ototoxicity, with valganciclovir's active metabolite ganciclovir potentiating aminoglycoside-induced renal and auditory toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function closely with baseline and regular serum creatinine/BUN measurements; consider alternative antivirals if possible; ensure adequate hydration and avoid other nephrotoxic agents; monitor for hearing loss.
